overview: This 164-page file documents Japan’s manufacturing under U.S. occupation from 1946 to 1949. Its largest component is a detailed fertilizer report with historical statistics and 1946 supply requirements. Correspondence and reports also address chemical plant recovery, petroleum refining, aluminum policy, industrial efficiency, exports, and production forecasts.
interest: The fertilizer report’s extensive historical tables sit alongside candid assessments of occupation policy and Japanese industrial inefficiency.
